topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 67 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (multicall, blocktimestamp, peripheryimmutablestate). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
